name: Tsuyoki na Danshi Koukousei ga Joshi Kousei ni Kugusurare Tsudzukeru Hanashi
original_name: 強気な男子高校生が女子高生にくすぐられ続ける話
source:
He may be a big guy, but his childhood friend is always teasing him.
When she finds out he's taken notice of her well-developed body, she decides it's a good chance for mischief. How will she punish him...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ218670.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]

他虽然是个大块头，但他儿时的朋友却总是取笑他。
当她发现他注意到她发育良好的身体时，她认为这是一个恶作剧的好机会。她要如何惩罚他……？
